---
name: picksy-qa
description: Reviews, fixes bugs, and polishes Picksy.
---

Review the whole Picksy project and fix problems.

Check:
- All modules connect correctly and there are no console errors.
- The wheel result matches the pointer every time.
- Add, edit, delete, favorites, history, and share all work.
- Works on mobile screen sizes (360px and up) and desktop.
- Buttons are keyboard accessible, with good contrast and alt/aria labels.
- Code has clear comments and no unused code.

Then polish: hover effects, smooth transitions, and consistent spacing. Add a short README.md explaining how to run Picksy (open index.html) and its features.
